findings: `window.scrollY` unguarded in NavComponent — nav.component.ts line 19 reads `window.scrollY` inside `@HostListener('window:scroll')` without a `typeof window !== 'undefined'` guard. Every other browser-API call in this codebase is guarded; this is the outlier. Wrap in the same guard for consistency.

`CommonModule` redundant import in NavComponent — nav.component.ts imports `CommonModule` in a standalone Angular 17 component that uses `@if`/`@for` block syntax. `CommonModule` contributes nothing and adds unnecessary bundle weight. Remove it.

Subject `<select>` missing `[value]` binding in contact form — the select has no `[value]` bound to the `subject()` signal. Currently benign because a successful submit hides the form. If a reset/send-another path is ever added, the visible selection will diverge from the signal. Add `[value]="subject()"` before extending the form.
